# Composition

Every seam the Tropos skills expose: each slot, its type, the skill that owns it,
the skills that preload its providers and the providers Tropos ships. The
[Project slots](instructions/AGENTS.md#project-slots) contract defines types,
priorities and shadowing; each owner's Slots section states what a slot covers.
